unlock_condition: Real count magnitudes remain locked. Unlock requires: (1) spatially adjusted V3 core recovery PASS; (2) nonzero H-main V5 recovery PASS; (3) V4 cross-species generality recovery PASS; and (4) V4 paper-level observation-source robustness PASS. Adelie species-specific exclude-unknown remains a disclosed limitation and cannot support universal wording even if the V4 paper-level statistic passes.

observation_pipeline.image_offset: One shared image-minus-direct offset. Within each site x species x season containing both known families, compute mean(log1p(image)) - mean(log1p(direct)); delta_image is the unweighted mean across mixed groups.
observation_pipeline.accuracy_scales: After subtracting the shared image offset, estimate sigma_1 and sigma_2_5 by pooling within-site x species x season residual sums of squares only among repeated records in the same collapsed accuracy group.
observation_pipeline.unknown_vantage: retain with no method mean shift; use its recorded accuracy class for observation precision; mandatory exclusion sensitivity
observation_pipeline.same_season_collapse: inverse estimated observation-variance weighted mean of method-corrected log1p counts
observation_pipeline.date_matched_method_sensitivity: secondary: recompute the image-direct offset from exact-date pairs and <=14-day pairs separately when estimable; do not replace the primary same-season offset based on which is more favorable

primary_process.loading_model: lambda_i = 1 + alpha_spatial_block[i] + gamma_A*A_within_block + gamma_H*H_within_block + gamma_AH*(A:H)_within_block + residual b_i
primary_process.singleton_rule: Singleton geographic blocks contribute a block intercept but zero centered trait leverage.
identification: one species-wide forcing has mean zero over annual transitions
site-trait columns are centered within frozen spatial adjustment blocks
residual b has mean zero within each spatial block
site-count-weighted block intercept mean is zero, implying species-wide mean lambda = 1
primary_process.note: Regional ADPE and CHPE latent forcing configurations are not used in real outcomes because they failed frozen integrated recovery; geography is retained only as an outcome-blind loading-adjustment block.

site_trait_models.standardization: A and H use the frozen 2 km transforms; trait effects are centered within the frozen V3 spatial adjustment block for each species.
site_trait_models.primary_crossover: V3 loading fit with A + H + A:H

crossover_definition.low_area_H_slope: gamma_H - gamma_AH; crossover label requires >= 0 at A=-1 SD
crossover_definition.high_area_H_slope: gamma_H + gamma_AH; crossover label requires < 0 at A=+1 SD
crossover_definition.wording_rule: Use 'option-fragmentation crossover' only when all three directional conditions hold. Otherwise describe an area-dependent heterogeneity effect.

recovered_components.gamma_H: nonzero H-main recovery passed in PAPER2_H_MAIN_RECOVERY_V5_RESULT_V1.json

site_trait_models.terrain_R: secondary only. Do not make a primary R or decoupling/local-instability claim without a separate nonzero R/process-variance recovery gate.
site_trait_models.mean_growth_secondary: mu/site-drift associations remain secondary and cannot replace a null lambda interaction.

inference.primary_paper_level_statistic: median of species-specific gamma_AH across ADPE, CHPE and GEPE
inference.species_specific_reporting: Always report all three V3 gamma_AH estimates and their species-specific block-preserving permutation results; no favorable subset selection.

directional_permutation.scheme: Within each species and frozen V3 spatial block, permute the complete site-trait tuple (A,H,A:H) among site time series. Singleton blocks remain fixed. Refit the complete V3 model for each permutation, including species-wide forcing, site drift, process SD, block intercepts and residual loadings. Compute the cross-species median gamma_AH for each joint permutation.
directional_permutation.p_value: (1 + number of permuted cross-species median gamma_AH <= observed median gamma_AH)/(9999+1)

inference.generality_rule: The paper-level claim is a cross-species Pygoscelis tendency, not universality. At least two of three observed species-specific gamma_AH estimates must be negative. Universal wording is prohibited unless all species-specific estimates and robustness lanes independently support the same classification.
inference.crossover_classification: In each species, use the crossover label only if gamma_AH<0, gamma_H-gamma_AH>=0 and gamma_H+gamma_AH<0.

mandatory_sensitivities.exclude_unknown_vantage: Final species-wide V3 support: ADPE=40, CHPE=30, GEPE=28. Adelie species-specific V3 recovery is limited (86/100 negative crossover) and must be disclosed. Paper-level robustness is judged by the frozen V4 cross-species median statistic.
mandatory_sensitivities.ground_only: Final species-wide V3 support: ADPE=14 (coverage-limited, nonblocking), CHPE=26, GEPE=23. Paper-level partial robustness uses CHPE+GEPE only and must retain both species.
mandatory_sensitivities.observation_timing: Report exact-date and <=14-day image-offset sensitivity when estimable; do not replace primary same-season calibration based on favorability.
mandatory_sensitivities.shannon: Tier 2 Shannon remains sensitivity-only; it cannot replace frozen Tier 2 richness.
mandatory_sensitivities.radii: 1 km and 5 km remain sensitivity-only; they cannot replace the 2 km primary traits.

process_variance_claim.rule: Process SD repeatedly reaches the profiling floor in pre-outcome recovery. Do not interpret local process variance, stability, or decoupling-with-instability in Paper 2 unless a separate recovery gate is designed and passed before outcomes.

terminal_rules: No new primary site trait, radius, temporal subset, spatial block, transform, or interaction may be introduced after counts are opened.
Do not return to regional forcing after species-wide forcing was selected by recovery.
Do not broaden raw-ground-only to the full direct family.
Do not relax the frozen recovery thresholds because Adelie species-specific exclude-unknown is underpowered.
A null or opposite cross-species median gamma_AH is a valid falsification and does not trigger model searching.
All species-specific results remain reported even when the paper-level median is primary.
The latent species-wide factor is not named as a specific climate mechanism without an independent environmental attribution analysis.
Results from superseded empirical PR #65 are not consulted to alter this contract.

required_pre_outcome_gates.integrated_v2: PASSED only at species-wide forcing; retained as model-development history
required_pre_outcome_gates.spatial_v3: PASSED and defines the final species-specific estimator
required_pre_outcome_gates.h_main_v5: PASSED and validates nonzero gamma_H recovery
required_pre_outcome_gates.paper_level_source_robustness: PASSED in V4 source-generality recovery, but counts remain locked until V4 generality itself passes
required_pre_outcome_gates.process_variance: not required for count opening because that ecological claim is blocked
